paragraphs: Comsof Fiber is automated planning and design software for telecom operators and engineering firms that need to scale fiber-optic networks quickly and cheaply. The product now belongs to IQGeo, which acquired Comsof NV in August 2022.

The claim made for it is that automation and optimization algorithms cut the end-to-end planning and design process by as much as 90 percent. The same optimization is said to strip out costly design choices and reuse existing infrastructure, lowering total build cost by up to 10 percent. Engineers can compare area costs, scenarios and architectures before settling on a design. Workflow templates let newer engineers repeat an established process and adjust the design outputs.

Two buyers are addressed directly, and network operators are told that legacy planning tools rarely scale to the demands of new deployments. Engineering design firms are told that hand-building multiple design scenarios does not hold up at higher volumes of fiber connections. The page states that IQGeo has over 100,000 active software users among fiber, telecom and utility companies worldwide.

quote.text: In August 2022, IQGeo acquired Comsof NV.
